d:
The Union Cabinet has approved major revisions to the Agnipath military recruitment scheme. While the initial four-year engagement and the 25% retention quota remain, the remaining 75% will now be offered an additional two-year engagement, with a direct pathway into the regular cadre at the six-year mark.
What does this mean for the original goals of Agnipath—namely a younger military profile, a reduced defence pension bill, and the return of trained youth to the civilian workforce?
In this video, we break down:
• Key changes approved under the revised framework
